FIELDS.NAME: Urban Threads Boutique
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: Jane Doe, Inspection Coordinator, Urban Threads Boutique, 1234 Fashion Lane, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78701-1234, Phone: (512) 555-0199, Email: jane.doe@urbanthreads.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Urban Threads Boutique operates as a retail clothing store located at 1234 Fashion Lane, Suite 100, Austin, TX. Our store focuses on offering a wide variety of fashionable apparel for men, women, and children. Our inventory is meticulously curated to meet the latest trends while ensuring quality and style. We prioritize maintaining an inventory valuation at or below $500,000 to optimize our asset protection against theft and loss claims.

Sales are primarily conducted through our physical store, with online sales making up less than 75% of total revenue, thus mitigating associated cyber and fulfillment risks. We have implemented robust inventory management software and point-of-sale systems that support efficient operations and loss prevention practices.

While we offer some incidental alterations services, they constitute less than 10% of our total activities, effectively minimizing exposure to liabilities typically associated with repair operations. Moreover, we comply with all local labor laws, safety standards, and consumer protection regulations to ensure a safe shopping environment for our customers.

Our team at Urban Threads is committed to providing exceptional customer service and enhancing the shopping experience through well-organized displays and a welcoming atmosphere. We look forward to continuing to serve our community with the latest in clothing and apparel.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On January 15, 2023, Urban Threads Boutique experienced a theft incident in which clothing inventory valued at $2,000 was stolen from the store after hours. The case is currently under investigation by local law enforcement, and we have implemented additional security measures, including increased surveillance, to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Sat 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sun 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B; Grade 1; UL Listed Safe
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard services during store hours and after hours to enhance theft prevention and ensure a safe shopping environment.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Business Personal Property (BPP) at 100% replacement cost value
